payload.title: Residual sequence-state evidence beyond E011
payload.statement: After well-level routing and specialization fail, legal row-sequence or physical state evidence may recover E011 residual shape without relying on train-only surfaces or public-well overrides.
payload.evidence_for: E010 proves a 4.7511 legal path-bank oracle and E011 remains at 12.5508, leaving substantial nonlinear path-state headroom. E011 residual decomposition retains material trend and shape structure. Public-source audits independently highlight posterior continuity and branch state, although their corrections are not valid evidence.
payload.evidence_against: E010 legal selection, E012 specialists, and T022 uncertainty routing all fail to identify safe action. HMM and DTW screens have not yet shown unique full-data wins. A sequence model can overfit autocorrelated GR or repeated motifs.
payload.next_test: Preregister a preimplementation sequence-state worth screen before any GRU/TCN or new path implementation. Quantify residual autocorrelation and oracle sequence capacity, then require a simple legal cross-fitted bounded sequence proxy to show repeatable gain and shift stability before neural or state-model code is allowed.
